steps: vsShot ui dur=26 run=vsSave at=6 help=0
title: Server Lag Watch
kicker: Farming Simulator 25 mod: what froze the server, and when it saves
probe: automatic: vsSave saves during play 6 s into the clip, so SERVER SAVE shows over the game

caption.heading: Every save stops the game
caption.text: On a server, everyone's game freezes for a moment while it saves.

caption.heading: SERVER SAVE
caption.text: Big red letters while it saves: nobody wonders why the game stopped.

caption.heading: Who froze it
caption.text: Every freeze over 250 ms: a notice with the slowest script, and a line in the log.
